layout_spacing.container: w-full max-w-[460px] md:max-w-[800px] mx-auto min-h-screen relative overflow-x-hidden bg-slate-50

Login.background: Fullscreen min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-pink-500/20 via-[#3a0f8a] to-[#2e0b70] p-6
elements: Ligo logo (white) animated scale-in at top center
Heading: 'Bem-vindo de volta' in white, massive text
CPF Input: border-b-2 border-white/30 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl p-4 text-white placeholder-white/50 text-2xl tracking-widest text-center focus:border-[#FF6A1A] outline-none
CTA Button: Large, #FF6A1A orange, full width, rounded-full py-4 text-white font-bold text-lg flex justify-center items-center 'Entrar →'
Footer hint: 'Só pra clientes Ligo ativos' text-white/60 text-sm text-center mt-6

Hub.header: Rich purple gradient (min-h-[300px]) with 'OLÁ, [Nome] 👋' in white + 'O que você quer fazer hoje?'. Top-right has 'Sair' pill button (glassmorphism).
Hub.sheet_card: White background, rounded-[24px], overlapping header by -mt-16. Contains Profile Avatar (Purple Circle + Initials), Masked CPF, Plano Contratado row (Blue square icon, 'Fibra 1 Giga', price), and Filial row.
Hub.actions: 2 large cards stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop. Card A: Indique e Ganhe (Purple Glass, 🎁). Card B: Minha Ligo (Purple Glass with Orange accent, 📡). Both use glassmorphism effects on top of the base app background.

IndiqueEGanhe.hero: Purple glass card. Top pill: '● PROGRAMA INDIQUE E GANHE'. Huge text: 'Indique um amigo e ganhe R$ 50 no PIX'. Info box with ☀️ emoji. 3 Step horizontal flow: INDICA → INSTALA → PIX (Pix step has solid orange bg).
IndiqueEGanhe.share_card: White sheet card. Contains referral URL, Copy btn, huge WhatsApp share btn, and 'Mostrar QR' toggle.
IndiqueEGanhe.kpis: Grid of 4 stats (Indicados, Instalados, Saldo R$, Total ganho) - large numbers, elegant typography.
IndiqueEGanhe.tiers: Gamified progress bar (Bronze, Prata, Ouro, Diamante) with animated shimmer fill via Framer Motion.
IndiqueEGanhe.leaderboard: Anonymous top-5 list + user's rank highlighted.
IndiqueEGanhe.referrals: List of friends with status pills (Pendente, Instalado, etc).
IndiqueEGanhe.pix_checkout: Form with PIX key input, Amount input, Method toggle (PIX/Desconto), 'Solicitar' button.

MinhaLigo.hero: Matches screenshot #1. Top pill '● MINHA LIGO' with orange dot. Huge text 'Olá, [Nome]!'. Subtitle 'Você está com o Ligo 1 Giga'. Green '● Ativo' pill.
MinhaLigo.sub_cards: Grid of 2 sub-cards: DOCUMENTO (ID badge emoji, masked CPF) and TELEFONE (Phone emoji, formatted phone).
MinhaLigo.invoices: List of invoices (Próxima fatura / Histórico). Placeholder empty states styled beautifully if no data.
MinhaLigo.support: Huge WhatsApp CTA button for support.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete UI in /app/frontend/src/cliente/ClienteIndicaApp.js using functional React components and Tailwind CSS.
Do NOT change backend endpoints or token logic. Integrate smoothly with the provided FastAPI routes.
Use Framer Motion (`framer-motion`) for all animations: slide-ups on mount, staggered list items, tap scaling, and the shimmering progress bar.

Typography is CRITICAL: Emulate Sora/Bricolage Grotesque by using tight tracking (`tracking-tighter`) and bold weights (`font-black`) for headings. Inject a Google Font link for 'Sora' dynamically in the component if possible, or stick to robust sans-serif stacks with customized letter-spacing.

Layout Architecture: The Hub, Indique, and Minha Ligo screens share a 'Layered Header' approach. The top background is a deep purple gradient. The content is wrapped in a white 'Sheet Card' (`bg-white rounded-[32px] shadow-2xl -mt-16 z-10 relative`) that overlaps the header. This creates the signature depth the user requested.
Emojis: Use standard emojis (👋 🎁 📡 💸 🏠 ☀️ 💳) to replicate the 3D tactile feel requested. Wrap them in accessible spans.
Glassmorphism: Strictly follow the `effects.glassmorphism` utility for the 'Indique e Ganhe' hero card and Hub cards when they are overlaid on the purple gradient.
Ensure all elements listed in 'test_ids' arrays are explicitly added to the components as `data-testid` attributes.
